title: docs(pm-skills): the undraft ccr route eats a GraphQL pool that /rate_limit cannot see
body:
Fixes #18601

`Clause-②: no`

One file: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, held at **466 / 466**
(headroom 0, widest line in the file still 120 B at `:21`, untouched). No ceiling raised, net line
change **0**: two rows rewritten in place, one row added, one dedup taken in the same file.
`skip-changeset` — `.claude/**` is shipped by no package's `files[]`, so nothing published moves.

Reserved rows are untouched, verified by content after the edit: `:10`–`:12` and `:431` (#18469
PR-A), PR #18666's one line (now at `:209`, byte identical), `:51` (was `:50`) and `:272` (PR
#18713), and the nine rows PR #18689 adopted (`:28`, `:86`, `:249`, `:277`–`:278`, `:291`, `:347`,
`:357`, `:393`, `:410` — none appears in any hunk of this diff).

## What the card measured, and what the table now says

The seat's only undraft channel, `POST .../pulls/{n}/ccr/ready_for_review`, draws on the **session
credential's hourly GraphQL quota** and answers **HTTP 429 with a zero-byte write** when that quota
is spent — `GET /pulls/{n}` still read `draft: true`. In the same minute, on the same credential,
`GET /rate_limit` reported `graphql` **10000 / 10000** and `core` 15000 / 15000. So the table's
prescription 「graphql remaining < 1000 ⇒ 本轮走 git 加 REST」 reads an instrument that cannot see
the pool that stops you, and a full reading is **not a pass** for the undraft act.

The reading is **one session's, one hour**: this seat's own arms today (four PRs) went through the
same ccr route without a 429. The row carries that by naming the pool as 会话凭据的 GraphQL 小时池
rather than generalising the trigger to the route as such.

## The undraft rows — `:47` rewritten, `:48` rewritten, `:49` added

**before** (`:47`, 97 B · `:48`, 118 B):

```text
- undraft 单通道:席位凭据走 `POST .../pulls/{n}/ccr/ready_for_review`;MCP 兜底已拒。
- 2026-09-12 两席实调:裸 GraphQL 会话内被拒,建议的 REST 正是 ccr 路 ⇒ 池 0 不再只能等重置。
```

**after** (`:47`, 115 B · `:48`, 116 B · `:49`, 104 B):

```text
- undraft 单通道:席位凭据走 `POST .../pulls/{n}/ccr/ready_for_review`;MCP 兜底与裸 GraphQL 均已拒。
- 2026-09-17 单席实测:该路吃会话凭据的 GraphQL 小时池,尽则 429 且零字节写入,`draft` 未动。
- 唯一可读信号是该 429 体自报的 `resets at` 时刻;体自带指令 ⛔ 重置前不重试。
```

`:48`'s facts are kept, not dropped. 「裸 GraphQL 会话内被拒」 folds into `:47` as 「MCP 兜底与裸
GraphQL 均已拒」, and 「建议的 REST 正是 ccr 路」 is what `:47`'s main clause already states — one
row for one fact. What is deleted is the tail 「⇒ 池 0 不再只能等重置」, and only because today's
reading is its reverse: the ccr route itself draws on the pool, so a spent pool is again a wait.
The routing rule is untouched — the seat still undrafts through this route; there is no second one.

`:49` carries the 429's own two halves: the `resets at` instant is the only readable signal that
exists before the act, and the refusal to retry is the body's own instruction, attributed to it so
that no retry cadence is invented here.

## The prescription row — `:162` (now `:163`) rewritten in place

**before** (109 B):

```text
- 它答不了通道在不在,repo-scoped 探针另跑;graphql remaining < 1000 ⇒ 本轮走 git 加 REST。
```

**after** (118 B):

```text
- graphql remaining < 1000 ⇒ 本轮走 git 加 REST;⛔ 满余额不放行 undraft:同分钟满额而 ccr 路 429。
```

## The payment — one dedup, `:223` folded into `:94`

| payment | before | after | fact lost |
|---|---|---|---|
| `:162` first clause dropped (in-file duplicate), which paid for the blind-spot clause in the same row | 「它答不了通道在不在,repo-scoped 探针另跑」 | — (clause removed) | the point-of-use restatement beside `:161`. The fact is held twice in the same section, 50+ rows earlier: `:106` 「开轮探一次…探针必须是一条真 repo-scoped 读」 and `:109` 「`/rate_limit` 照答 200,兼任不了探针」 |
| `:223` deleted, its one unique clause folded into `:94` (78 B → 103 B, now `:95`), which paid for the new row `:49` | 「配额按账户计,不跨席共享:各席位跑在不同 GitHub 账户下。」 + 「配额池按身份计,换身份即清零燃烧,共享身份结构不变。」 | 「配额按账户计,不跨席共享:各席位跑在不同 GitHub 账户下;换身份即清零燃烧。」 | 「共享身份结构不变」 — held by `:96` 「所有 agent 共用一个身份只在席位内部成立」 and `:97` 「⛔ 不据限流报文里的 user ID 推池子跨席共用」 (post-edit numbering). 「配额池按身份计」 is the same statement as the kept row's opening clause |

Net: 5 lines changed, 466 in, 466 out.

## Why this row shape — the four axes

- **实际业务需求** — measured, not speculative: a green, reviewed, clause-②-PASS undraft was stuck
  27 minutes with no readable indicator before the act. Both edited sites are points of use: a seat
  reads `:47`–`:49` at the moment it undrafts, and `:163` at the start of a round, when it budgets
  the pool. Writing the fact at one site only would leave the other reading exactly as it read this
  morning — which is how the seat got there.
- **项目长远合理性** — no workaround: no second channel is invented, no probe is added, and the
  correction is made where the falsified claim lives rather than appended as a caveat. The stale
  tail is removed instead of being qualified, so the table keeps one statement per fact.
- **防 AI 写代码犯错** — the axis that decides the shape. The failure mode here is a **tolerant
  reading**: 10000 / 10000 looks like clearance, and the seat acts on it. So the prescription row
  itself carries the refusal (`⛔ 满余额不放行 undraft`) with its own evidence (同分钟满额而 ccr 路
  429) rather than a pointer to another row — a reader who never scrolls to `:47` still cannot read
  a full balance as a pass. Splitting the undraft fact across `:48` and `:49` is what bought room
  for the `resets at` instant; folding both into one row would have dropped it, and it is the only
  signal a seat can act on.
- **创业阶段不扩散需求** — zero net lines, zero new surface, zero tooling. The card's second
  suggestion (make the 429's named wait a legal state in the landing flow) is a `SKILL.md` /
  lane-text matter and is deliberately NOT written here; it is raised in the report's
  `open_questions` instead.

The alternative shape — both facts in one new row — was rejected on the third axis: at ≤ 120 B one
row holds either the pool ownership or the instrument blind spot, not both, and the half that would
have been dropped is the half a seat reads at round start.

## Gate readings

`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`
exits **3 = GOVERNED** (`.claude/**`) — recorded as the verdict it is. This PR stays draft; this
branch never flips ready and never arms auto-merge. The skills seat's `## Contract review` record
goes on this thread, and the seat lands it.

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` :: exit 0 — 「platform-readings.md is 466 lines (ceiling 466;
  headroom 0)」, 「widest table row is 0 bytes (pin 0; headroom 0)」.
- `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` :: exit 0 — 「the one declared copy of the decision frame is
  internally coherent … 4 axes … 74 markdown files scanned for undeclared copies」.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide, `eslint . --no-inline-config`) :: exit 0.
- Byte discipline: `LC_ALL=C awk 'length($0) > 120'` over the file prints nothing; `grep -naP` for
  control characters prints nothing; nothing tag-shaped is written in the new rows.

(no hand-fed paths; change set 1 path vs merge base `080688b56`), every command run, each exit code

`check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited **3 — PREREQUISITE NOT MET** (`@objectstack/lint` not
built, 「Nothing was measured」), which is not a failed measurement. It was re-run to a real verdict
after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` through
`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 167s · waited 0s`); only the
exit 0 is recorded above.

Reconciliation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran ran.txt`
→ 「18 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 18 recorded
an exit code and none of them is 3)」. Outside that union and named so their absence is not read as
clearance: the 53 artifact-roster families, the 11 wide-population families, the 14
changeset-pending families and the CI-only families (`--verify-required-set`, `check-half-states
--provenance`) — CI's, not this branch's.

## Acceptance notes

- Noted, not filed: nothing in this diff's neighbourhood is a defect of its own except the item
  raised in the report's `out_of_scope_findings` (three rows in the 配额 section rest on the same
  rationale this card falsified — 「ccr 路是 REST ⇒ 不吃 GraphQL 池」 — and correcting them needs a
  measurement nobody has taken: whether a `/rate_limit`-red window predicts a ccr 429 at all). That
  one is filed rather than fixed here: the fix shape is not pinned, and the dispatch scopes the
  routing and red-window scheduling rules out of this PR.
